title: STILL PRESENT (r3): the wrong-person awaiting UPDATE is still unguarded on taken_over_at — the dedicated backstop SQL is orphaned (dead code wired to nothing), and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235-1256: `case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token) False -> case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_wrong_person(config, row, id_uuid, token) False -> case sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)`; update_reference_call_status.sql:23-24: `WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status`; mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql (backstop present: `AND status = 'contact_initiated'::reference_call_status AND taken_over_at IS NULL`) has NO production callers — grep of server/src shows only the sql.gleam definition; the only call sites are the test's direct calls at server/test/integration/reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:1746,1758
detail: The executed awaiting UPDATE still guards only on status; take-over preserves status (A7 stickiness) so a take-over between token read and UPDATE still yanks a landlord-handled row into awaiting_correction. The r3-rework shipped the guarded SQL + a direct-SQL test but never wired the handler to it. Webhook leg (mark_awaiting_correction.sql) carries the backstop; wrong-person leg is the lone inconsistent writer.
recommended_fix: In apply_wrong_person's correction_cycles == 0 branch, execute sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person (0 rows -> redirect); drop the orphaned read-time branch. Add a race test driving the real POST route with the take-over committed between read and UPDATE (e.g. trigger via a hook/transaction), which turns red if the backstop is neutralized.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): spec-rc4-3-row-actions.md still names the deleted substitute_reference_call.sql and still claims "One additive column" while the migration ships corrected_name + corrected_at
evidence: spec-rc4-3-row-actions.md:73: "`take_over_reference_call.sql`, `correct_reference_call.sql` (guard + corrected_* + cycle bump + re-arm in ONE update), `substitute_reference_call.sql` (reads the old row's slot/owner + verifies the pre-state guard)"; spec-rc4-3-row-actions.md:232: "effective name.
